input: nums is a plain dense Array of Number integers in increasing order; target is a Number integer. Preconditions are not checked at runtime.
return: A Number integer in [0, n]: the first index whose value is at least target, or n. Empty input returns 0. If duplicate values are supplied, the first matching position is returned as an explicit extension, not a predecessor-equivalence claim.
mutation_aliasing: No input writes, sorting or copies. The result is a Number integer. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Values and target are safe integers in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]; NaN, infinities and BigInt are excluded. Array indices and length are exact Numbers. The midpoint uses Math.floor without bitwise truncation, and no target arithmetic is used.
complexity: O(log(n + 1)) time and O(1) auxiliary space under constant-cost indexing and Number comparisons.

helpers.name: lowerBound
helpers.contract: Returns the first index whose value is at least target, or n; searches [left, right).
helpers.cost: One call, O(log(n + 1)) time and O(1) space. Its complete identical definition is included in each of the three search candidates.
